method.routing: Amap walking and integrated transit, fixed GCJ-02 POI to POI. One way. Distance is modeled network length and time is map-estimated.
method.transit_selection: Up to three map options retained, sorted by duration and, for new equal-duration results, by the walking portion. Option zero is used in the table. Services within a leg are alternatives.
method.actual_arrival_window: All returned preferred Amap PC routes had a modelled arrival within 07:30–08:00 China Standard Time.
method.time_gap: Amap PC departure set to 2026-11-12 07:20 CST (ordinary Thursday). Arrival is departure plus the displayed whole-minute travel time, not a directly specified arrival time or an observed school trip. Earlier integrated route estimates remain untouched and untimed.
method.accessibility: Named roads and junctions are map-derived checks. Actual pedestrian gates, crossings and route passability have not been field-verified.
method.fare: Amap PC displayed adult single-journey estimates where present. Single-ride Line 5 Liede–Tancun also cross-checked against the operator tariff. Null means unavailable.
method.samples: Three residential POIs and six sampled kindergarten campuses, including two campuses of one operator. Thresholds are inclusive and use seconds before rounding.
method.pc_transit_selection: First valid motorized itinerary in Amap PC recommended order. Alternative cards and the preferred route's visible details are retained. Quotes are modelled.
